habitat: Deciduous woods, forest edges and gardens
hostPlants: Wild cherry, tulip tree and other broadleaf trees
season: Spring through fall; timing varies by latitude
identification: Yellow wings with black tiger stripes and a tail on each hindwing. Some females are dark.
fact: Females occur in yellow and dark forms.
form: Representative form; individual colors and markings vary

source.title: Butterflies and Moths of North America
